role_goal: Запустить удаленную научную разработку FormulaLM/Qwen: воспроизводимый benchmark, улучшение harness, артефакты, отчет и следующий план экспериментов.
goal: Исполни remote-only научную разработку FormulaLM/Qwen. Не запускай FormulaLM, Qwen, QW 2.5, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM или любые model benchmark на Mac/Darwin. Работай только как lease-владелец на remote Linux node через Control Plane. Прочитай docs/formulalm.md, docs/agent-work/formulalm-remote-rd-pack.md и scripts/formulalm_benchmark.py. Сначала запиши preflight artifact до любого model call: task_id, node_id, hostname, uname, platform.system, repo commit, CPU/RAM/disk, runtime candidates, model candidates, dataset version, pricebook version, artifact_dir. Если OS Darwin или runtime/model недоступны, не имитируй успех: запиши blockers.json и Markdown blocker report. Если remote runtime готов, запусти научную программу: 1) smoke benchmark 5 cases x 2 repeats; 2) pilot benchmark 20 cases x 5 repeats или максимально доступный dataset; 3) six-hour run только если lease/runtime безопасны. Baseline и FormulaLM должны использовать одну модель, один dataset и одинаковые generation settings. Если scripts/formulalm_benchmark.py не покрывает метрики H1-H5, доработай harness и тесты: unique_output_hashes_per_case, parse_error_rate, runtime_error_rate, formula_consistency_rate, latency p50/p95, blocked_reason_count. Сохрани все результаты в docs/agent-work/formulalm-scientific-rd-20260629/ и итоговый отчет docs/agent-work/formulalm-scientific-rd-20260629.md. Коммить и пушь ветку агента. Верни result_reference, changed_files, checks, commit, pushed=true и verdict: proven, inconclusive или blocked.

remote_guard.mac_policy: Mac is control/editing surface only; model calls on Darwin are forbidden.
remote_guard.darwin_action: write preflight.json and blockers.json, then stop before any model call
remote_guard.linux_action: run benchmark only after runtime, model, dataset and pricebook checks pass

hypotheses: H1 valid_json_rate improves by at least 5 percentage points
H2 exact_total_rate reaches at least 0.98 and improves baseline by at least 0.10
H3 unique_output_hashes_per_case is at most 2 and at least 50 percent lower than baseline
H5 manual_fix_count is at least 30 percent lower after QA review

acceptance: No model experiment runs on macOS or the owner's Mac
Remote preflight artifact is written before any model call
If runtime/model/dataset is missing, task returns blocker artifact instead of synthetic success
If runtime is ready, benchmark compares baseline and FormulaLM with the same model, dataset and generation settings
Harness gaps for H1-H5 metrics are fixed or explicitly recorded as blockers with a next patch
Artifacts include JSON and Markdown reports under docs/agent-work/formulalm-scientific-rd-20260629/
Final report contains verdict proven, inconclusive or blocked with evidence
Agent commits and pushes its branch, and Control Plane result includes changed_files, checks, commit and result_reference

source.rule: remote-only scientific development; Mac is control/editing surface only
